RR 1797 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT This AGREEMENT made as of this  day of f6/Va, 2016 (this “Agreement"), between Vitale Sclafani Holdings LLC, a New York Limited Liability Company having an office at 9711 Third Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11209 (hereinafter referred to as "Seller") and 9703 Builders LLC, a New York Limited Liability Company having an office at 1850 83rd Street, Brooklyn, New York 11209 (hereinafter referred to as “Developer"). RECITALS: A. Seller is the owner of certain land known by the street address 9711-9713 Third Avenue,Brooklyn,NewYork 11209,alsoknown asTaxLot 7inBlock6126on the TaxMap of the City of New York, County of Kings, more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the improvements thereon (said land being herein referred to as “Seller's Land,” and said improvements, together with any future replacements thereof, being herein referred to as “Seller's Existing Building,” and Seller's Land and Seller's Existing Building collectively being herein referred to as “Seller's Property"). B. Developer is the owner of certain land adjacent to Seller's Land known by the street address 9701-9709 Third Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11209, also known as Tax Lot 12 in Block 6126 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings, more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the existing improvements thereon (said land as same may be expanded or diminished by Developer, and together with any development rights appurtenant to properties directly or indirectly contiguous to said land or Seller's Property, collectively being herein referred to as “Developer's Land" and said improvements collectively being herein referred to as *Developer's Existing Building"). c. Developer may renovate Developer's Existing Building or construct a new building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Developer's Land (said new or renovated building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, being herein referred to as “Developer's Proposed Building” and Developer's Land and Developer's Proposed Building being herein referred to as “Developer's Property"). D.Seller and Developer wish to merge Developer's Property and Seller's Property into a single “zoning lot,” as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time (the “Zoning Resolution") (such single zoning lot being herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot"), so as to create a new, combined zoning lot, which zoning lot may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with the terms of this Agreement, for the purpose of making available the Excess Development Rights (as defined below) and any Floor Area Development Rights from the Additional Parcels acquired by Developer for utilization in connection with the construction of the Developer'sProposedBuilding; E. Seller and Developer have been advised that on the date hereof Seller's Existing Building uses less than the maximum Floor Area Development Rights that are permitted for development on Seller's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and that, therefore, Seller has available the Excess Development Rights that, under procedures currently available under the

Zoning Resolution, may be made available to permit the construction of Developer's Proposed Building with Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available. F. Seller wishes to sell in perpetuity to Developer, and Developer wishes to purchase, the Excess Development Rights in order that Developer's Proposed Building be permitted to have Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available and, in any event, that Developer shall be the owner of the Excess Development Rights which is 5,764.5 square feet, as shown on the Floor Area and Development Right Survey dated October 14, 2015 attached as Exhibit D. G. The parties hereto (among others) have simultaneously herewith executed and delivered a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration"), attached hereto as Exhibit C, which is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording in the Kings County Office of the Register of The City of New York with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot. H. Seller's Land is contiguous with Developer's Land for at least ten (10) linear feet, andSeller'sLand andDeveloper's Land are all within a singleblock. NOW, THEREFORE, the parties agree as follows: ARTICLEI DEFINITIONS Section 1.1. Definitions. As used herein: a. "Additional Parcel" shall mean any Tax Lot (other than Tax Lots 7 and 12) located in Block 6126 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Borough of Brooklyn, which may be d  n d      n     m  of the Zoning Resolution and this Agreement. b. "Additional Development Rights"”' shall mean any additional Floor Area Development Rights that may become available to the Combined Zoning Lot by expansion of the Combined Zoning Lot by adding an Additional Parcel. c. "Bonus Development Rights" shall mean any Floor Area Development Rights and other development rights pertaining to a zoning lot that may become available for inclusion in a building constructed thereon pursuant to the Zoning Resolution by reason of the provision of an amenity or public benefit either on or off the zoning lot, including, but not limited by any other procedure or transfer allowed under the provisions of the Zoning Resolution, including, but not limited to, Section 23-90 et seq. d. "Datum Level' shall mean the North American Vertical Datum 1988. e.
